column1: # *** THE MARRIAGE OF SANCHO LLERENA AND MARIA FERNANDEZ, 8 JANUARY 1791. ***
# Canelones, Parroquia de Nuestra Senora de Guadalupe, Matrimonios Libro I.
# DGS 8166578, IMAGE 2687, left page, second act. Read off the image on 15 September 2026.
# Every quotation below was transcribed from the image at magnification, not from an index.
*** SANCHO LLERENA'S MARRIAGE ACT, FOUND AND READ. 15 September 2026. ***
column2: *** Canelones, Parroquia de Nuestra Senora de Guadalupe, Matrimonios Libro I - DGS 8166578, IMAGE 2687, left page, second act. ***
column4: *** THE DOCUMENT THIS ARCHIVE HAS BEEN CHASING SINCE THE BEGINNING. *** Found by walking the reel by image number: 2670 read February 1789 and 2700 read June 1792, which put January 1791 near 2687. *** The marginal heading reads 'Sancho Llerena, y Maria Fernandes. Casados y Velados'. ***

column2: *** 'En ocho dias del Mes de Enero de 1791 anos' ***
column4: *** 8 JANUARY 1791 - EXACTLY WHAT APOLANT'S FICHA 355 SAID. *** And it is written *** 1791 in figures ***, not spelled out, so the 'noventa versus ochenta' trap that has cost this archive days does not arise. *** Apolant is now corroborated by the act itself, and the date is PRIMARY rather than published-secondary. ***

column2: '...justificacion de libertad de *** Sancho Llerena, nat[ura]l de Cordova la Llana ***...'
column4: *** CORDOBA, NOT GRANADA - AND ON AN ACT, NOT A TREE. *** This archive had Cordoba from unsourced Geneanet trees and a competing Granada reading, and had honestly recorded that Cordoba 'rests on ONE UNSOURCED NOTE'. It does not any more. *** HONEST CAVEAT ON THE SECOND WORD: the hand does not separate m from n, so 'la Llana' and 'la Llama' are both readable, and no modern municipality of either name has been identified yet. *** What is NOT ambiguous is *** Cordova ***, which is written twice on the act. The qualifier is a lead to run down, not a finding.

column2: '...hijo legitimo de *** Felix Llerena, y de Rosalia Aguilar, nat[ura]les de dicha Cordova ***...'
column4: *** THE SECOND INDEPENDENT PRIMARY WITNESS TO FELIX AND ROSALIA. *** The 1811 baptism of their grandson Luis gave 'Abuelos paternos Feliz Gerena y Rosalia Aguilar'. *** Two parish acts, twenty years apart, in two different parishes, agree on both names *** - and this one adds what 1811 did not: *** the parents were themselves of Cordoba. *** That is the first evidence placing the previous generation anywhere at all.

column2: '...con *** Maria Fernandez, nat[ura]l de las Asturias, hija legitima de Rodrigo Fernandez, y de Ro[sa] Fernandez, naturales de dichas Asturias, y Vecinos de S[an]ta Lucia ***...'
column4: *** CONFIRMS THE 1811 ACT AGAIN, AND CORRECTS THE TREES. *** The 1811 baptism gave 'idem maternos Rodrigo Fernandez y Rosa Fernandez'; the act gives the same couple. *** The Geneanet note this archive recorded said her father was 'RAMON Fernandez Tresguerras' - the act says RODRIGO. *** Where a tree and an act disagree the act wins. *** Note also 'Vecinos de Santa Lucia' *** - the bride's family were settled there, which is new, and the 1812 padron later puts Rodrigo Fernandez, 63, asturiano, living in Sancho's own household.

column1: *** WHO MARRIED THEM, AND WHO WATCHED ***
column2: 'Yo D[o]n *** Juan Fran[cis]co Cardoso, Cura Interino de esta Parroq[uia] de Guadalupe ***, despose en ella, por palabras de presente, segun forma de N[uest]ra M[adr]e la Iglesia... siendo testigos *** Antonio Villegas, y Jose del Rio ***'
column4: *** JOSE DEL RIO IS THE SAME MAN WHO WROTE SANCHO'S 1798 DEPOSITION *** as Notario Ecclesiastico of the same vicaria. He stood as a witness at the wedding in 1791 and was still writing the parish's informaciones seven years later. *** Cardoso is 'Cura Interino' *** because Don Juan Miguel de Laguna, who signed the 1788 informacion, is called *** 'el finado' *** in an act of February 1789 - the parish was between priests.

*** THEY WERE BOTH MARRIED AND VELADOS *** - the nuptial blessing was given, not deferred, which the act's closing line begins to record ('Y asimismo di a los men[cionados]...'). The two numbers are the fees: six to the priest, three to the fabrica.

column2: *** No age, no occupation, no regiment, and no parents' status. ***
column4: *** WORTH STATING SO THAT NOBODY LATER REMEMBERS MORE THAN THE ACT CONTAINS. *** It does not call him 'Don', it does not call him a soldier, and it gives no age from which to compute a birth year. *** The trees' 'born about 1767' is still a tree. *** It also does not name the place in Cordoba beyond that disputed second word. *** The informacion that would have carried his age and his years in the country does not survive *** - see data/informaciones-1791-walk.tsv.

column1: *** HOW IT WAS FOUND, FOR THE NEXT PERSON ***
column4: Matrimonios Libro I opens at image 2590 behind a target board at 2586. *** Anchors read on the way: 2670 = 12 February 1789; 2687 = 8 January 1791; 2700 = 16 June 1792 *** - roughly nine images to the year. *** The whole reel was read without the FamilySearch viewer and while www.familysearch.org was returning Error 15 ***, by addressing images on the tile service by film-and-number. The technique is in the session memory.
